  number of times with a pause between attempts, and treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
- A value two servers can change at once — currency, inventory, a shared counter — is written with
  UpdateAsync and a transform that reads the CURRENT value. A GetAsync/SetAsync pair silently loses

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local SWORD_PRICE = 100
local ITEMS = {
	Sword = { Price = 100, ToolName = "Sword" },
}

local buyItem = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyItem.Name = "BuyItem"
buyItem.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local function getCoins(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

buyItem.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, itemName: unknown)
	if typeof(itemName) ~= "string" then
		return
	end

	local item = ITEMS[itemName]
	if not item then
		return
	end

	local coinsValue = getCoins(player)
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end

	local currentCoins = coinsValue.Value
	if currentCoins < SWORD_PRICE then
		return
	end

	-- Re-check that the player doesn't already own the tool
	if player.Backpack:FindFirstChild(item.ToolName) or player.Character:FindFirstChild(item.ToolName) then
		return
	end

	coinsValue.Value = currentCoins - SWORD_PRICE

	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = item.ToolName
	tool.RequiresHandle = true

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 4, 0.4)
	handle.Parent = tool

	tool.Parent = player.Backpack
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local buyPotion = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
buyPotion.Name = "BuyPotion"

local function getLeaderstat(player: Player, name: string): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return nil
	end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild(name) :: IntValue?

buyPotion.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, quantity: unknown)
	-- Validate the client-supplied quantity: must be a positive whole number.
	if typeof(quantity) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if quantity ~= quantity or quantity % 1 ~= 0 or quantity < 1 or quantity > 100 then
		return
	end

	local coins = getLeaderstat(player, "Coins")
	local potions = getLeaderstat(player, "Potions")
	if not coins or not potions then
		return
	end

	local totalCost = POTION_COST * quantity
	if coins.Value < totalCost then
		return
	end

	coins.Value -= totalCost
	potions.Value += quantity
end)

	if existing and existing:IsA("StringValue") then

	end
	local value = Instance.new("StringValue")
	value.Name = "PetName"
	value.Value = ""
	value.Parent = player
	return value

local function isValidName(name: unknown): boolean
	if typeof(name) ~= "string" then
		return false
	end
	local trimmed = name:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
	if #trimmed < MIN_NAME_LENGTH or #trimmed > MAX_NAME_LENGTH then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveCoins(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then
		return
	end
	local coinsValue = leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue or not coinsValue:IsA("IntValue") then
		return
	end

	local coins = coinsValue.Value
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	local success = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so a save never clobbers a concurrent write from another server
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				local data = current
				if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
					data = {}
				end
				data.Coins = coins
				return data
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			success = true
			break
		end
		warn(string.format("Save attempt %d failed for %s: %s", attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not success then
		warn(string.format("Failed to save coins for %s after %d attempts (unsaved)", player.Name, MAX_ATTEMPTS))
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(saveCoins)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saveCoins(player)
	end
end)

-- ModuleScript in ServerScriptService (or ServerStorage)
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")

local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 1

local function addCoins(userId: number, amount: number): number?
	if amount <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local newTotal: number? = nil

	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. userId, function(current)
				-- current may be nil (first visit) or a table of saved data
				local data = current
				if type(data) ~= "table" then
					data = { Coins = 0 }
				end

				local coins = tonumber(data.Coins) or 0
				coins += amount
				data.Coins = coins
				newTotal = coins
				return data
			end)
		end)

		if success then
			return newTotal
		end

		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end

	-- All attempts failed; treat as unsaved rather than returning a bogus total
	warn(("addCoins failed for userId %d after %d attempts"):format(userId, MAX_RETRIES))
	return nil
end

return {
	addCoins = addCoins,
}

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function saveInventory(player)
	local inventory = player:GetAttribute("Inventory")
	if inventory == nil then
		return -- nothing to save
	end

	local key = "Inv_" .. player.UserId

	-- Save with bounded retries; treat a call that never succeeded as unsaved.
	local saved = false
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			-- UpdateAsync so a concurrent write from another server isn't lost.
			store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
				return inventory
			end)
		end)
		if ok then
			saved = true
			break
		end
		warn(("Inventory save attempt %d failed for %s: %s"):format(attempt, player.Name, tostring(err)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end

	if not saved then
		warn(("Failed to save inventory for %s; session data NOT saved."):format(player.Name))
		return
	end

	-- Post the same inventory to the analytics endpoint (best effort).
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		HttpService:PostAsync(
			"https://example.com/log",
			HttpService:JSONEncode({
				userId = player.UserId,
				inventory = inventory,
				timestamp = os.time(),
			}),
			Enum.HttpContentType.ApplicationJson
		)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(("Analytics post failed for %s: %s"):format(player.Name, tostring(err)))
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	-- Wrap in task.spawn so one player's save doesn't block others leaving.
	task.spawn(saveInventory, player)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		saveInventory(player)
	end
end)

--!strict
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 4
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local loaded = {} :: {[Player]: boolean}

local function getCoinsValue(player: Player): IntValue?
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	if not leaderstats then return nil end
	return leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins") :: IntValue?
end

local function retry<T>(fn: () -> T): (boolean, T?)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY * attempt)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function save(player: Player): boolean
	local coinsValue = getCoinsValue(player)
	if not coinsValue then return false end
	local coins = coinsValue.Value
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId

	local ok = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			-- read the CURRENT stored value so we never clobber another server's write
			local data = current
			if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
				data = {}
			end
			data.Coins = coins
			return data
		end)
	end)

	return ok
end

local function onAdded(player: Player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coins.Name = "Coins"
	coins.Value = 0
	coins.Parent = leaderstats

	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, data = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)

	if ok then
		-- load succeeded (data may legitimately be nil for a new player)
		if typeof(data) == "table" and typeof(data.Coins) == "number" then
			coins.Value = math.floor(data.Coins)
		end
		loaded[player] = true
	else
		-- load failed: NOT an empty account. Skip saving this session so we
		-- never write a default over real data.
		warn(("[PlayerData] Failed to load data for %s; saving disabled this session."):format(player.Name))
		loaded[player] = false
	end
end

local function onRemoving(player: Player)
	if loaded[player] == false then
		loaded[player] = nil
		return -- never overwrite data we failed to load
	end
	local ok = save(player)
	if not ok then
		warn(("[PlayerData] FAILED to save data for %s."):format(player.Name))
	end
	loaded[player] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onRemoving)

-- Nobody may lose progress when the server shuts down.
game:BindToClose(function()
	if RunService:IsStudio() and #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 then
		return
	end
	local saving = {}
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		saving[player] = task.spawn(function()
			if loaded[player] ~= false then
				save(player)
			end
		end)
	end
	-- give saves up to ~25s to finish (BindToClose allows 30s)
	local deadline = os.clock() + 25
	for player, thread in saving do
		local remaining = deadline - os.clock()
		if remaining > 0 then
			task.wait(remaining)
		end
		if coroutine.status(thread) == "suspended" then
			warn(("[PlayerData] Save did not finish in time for %s."):format(player.Name))
		end
	end
end)

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local MAX_RETRIES = 3
local RETRY_DELAY = 2

local function retry(fn)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_RETRIES do
		local ok, result = pcall(fn)
		if ok then
			return true, result
		end
		warn(("DataStore attempt %d failed: %s"):format(attempt, tostring(result)))
		if attempt < MAX_RETRIES then
			task.wait(RETRY_DELAY)
		end
	end
	return false, nil
end

local function loadCoins(player)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local ok, coins = retry(function()
		return store:GetAsync(key)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(("Failed to load data for %s; skipping save this session."):format(player.Name))
		return nil
	end
	return coins or 0
end

local function saveCoins(player, coins)
	local key = "Player_" .. player.UserId
	local ok = retry(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(key, function(current)
			return coins
		end)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(("Failed to save coins for %s."):format(player.Name))
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder")
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	leaderstats.Parent = player

	local coinsValue = Instance.new("IntValue")
	coinsValue.Name = "Coins"
	coinsValue.Parent = leaderstats

	local coins = loadCoins(player)
	if coins == nil then
		-- Load failed: don't overwrite a real account with a default.
		coinsValue:SetAttribute("LoadFailed", true)
		coinsValue.Value = 0
		return
	end
	coinsValue.Value = coins
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
	if not coinsValue then
		return
	end
	if coinsValue:GetAttribute("LoadFailed") then
		warn(("Not saving for %s: data never loaded."):format(player.Name))
		return
	end
	saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local leaderstats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
		local coinsValue = leaderstats and leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
		if coinsValue and not coinsValue:GetAttribute("LoadFailed") then
			saveCoins(player, coinsValue.Value)
		end
	end
end)
